_comment: Sample data for demo.py — quality over quantity. Every competitor item is a REAL publication or announcement: title, URL, and publication date (>= 2026-07-01) verified live on 2026-09-01; days_ago matches the actual publication date. Summaries are short condensations in the pipeline's style. Client companies (Nordwind, Cantara, Veltena, Brenner) are entirely fictional and appear only in the newsletter demo, never in the dashboard.

signals.title: The state of AI in 2026: On the road to ROI
signals.summary: Global survey of 1,700+ respondents: 89% use AI in at least one function and 44% have scaled it across the organisation, yet only 6% qualify as high performers attributing 5%+ of EBIT to AI. The scaling-to-value gap is the core message.

signals.title: How to close the agentic adoption gap
signals.summary: Argues AI transformations are a reinvention of how work gets done: successful adopters spend $3 on process redesign and $5 on capability building for every $1 on agentic technology — most companies invert the ratio.

signals.title: AI Agents are Only the Beginning: Deloitte Survey Examines the AI Readiness Gap
signals.summary: Survey of 501 senior leaders: 74% expect nearly half of business processes to be redesigned or rebuilt around AI agents within four years, yet only 5% say their processes are highly prepared today.

signals.title: What does the rise in agentic AI mean for Global Business Services?
signals.summary: Dbriefs session on how agentic AI reorients GBS from transactional execution toward oversight and orchestration — organisational rethinking, adoption strategy, and implementation barriers.

signals.title: PwC and OpenAI launch agentic contact and service solutions
signals.summary: PwC US launches an 'agentic front office' for customer engagement and service, developed with OpenAI — a productised competitor offering built on a frontier-lab partnership.

signals.title: KPMG Quarterly AI Pulse Survey: Technology
signals.summary: Quarterly pulse of technology leaders: AI investment and agent adoption hold steady while leading firms shift focus from deployment to coordination, cost visibility, and executive accountability.

signals.title: Accenture Edge and Google Cloud Bring Scalable Agentic AI Solutions to Mid-Market Companies
signals.summary: Pre-built, industry-specific agent solutions for mid-market companies ($300M–$3B revenue) — packaged agentic delivery moving down-market, with implications for services pricing.

signals.title: Nordwind Industries announces new group CFO effective January
signals.summary: Leadership change at the top of the finance function. The incoming CFO arrives from a company known for a centralised GBS model — a common precursor to operating model review and a natural engagement window.

signals.title: Nordwind to consolidate European back-office functions in Lisbon hub
signals.summary: Announces consolidation of finance and HR back-office activities into a single European hub. Signals an active shared services agenda with likely demand for transition and process design support.

signals.title: Cantara Group launches group-wide ERP consolidation programme
signals.summary: Multi-year programme to consolidate regional ERP instances onto a single platform. Indicates budget committed to finance infrastructure and openness to transformation partners.

signals.title: Veltena Pharma plans shared services expansion into Krakow
signals.summary: Expansion of the existing shared services footprint with a new Krakow site focused on record-to-report and procurement operations. Direct signal of GBS build-out with near-term advisory needs.

signals.title: Brenner Logistics flags cost programme alongside quarterly results
signals.summary: Quarterly results accompanied by a group-wide cost programme announcement. Cost pressure often precedes shared services and automation initiatives; worth monitoring for scope details.
